chunks: and (says): 'In the name of Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.
ai.seo_question: Who is the source of the message and what is the opening invocation?
ai.summary: This verse introduces the letter of Solomon to the Queen of Sheba, emphasizing the divine origin of his wisdom and authority as a prophet-king. In Shia exegesis, this 'Basmala' underscores the continuity of prophetic revelation and Solomon's role in conveying God's message to the Gentiles, linking his diplomatic wisdom to spiritual guidance.
